The lake's name, "Ba Mau," is steeped in history, derived from the ancient Vietnamese unit of land measurement, "mẫu," which was equivalent to three such units.

This picturesque lake, with its soft, winding contours, has evolved from a natural area of ponds and lakes linked to agricultural life, gradually becoming an integral part of the city's urban fabric.
